abort.build_failed: Downloading or indexing the transit schedule failed: {error}

error.no_results: No feeds matched your search. Try a different provider or city name.
error.search_or_select: Enter a search query or pick a feed from the results.

progress.build: Downloading and indexing the transit schedule. This can take a few minutes for large feeds.

data_description.api_key: API key issued by the transit data producer

api_key.description: This feed's realtime data requires an API key issued by the transit provider. See [the provider's instructions]({authentication_info_url}) for how to get one.

reauth_api_key.description: The transit provider rejected the configured API key. Enter a new one. See [the provider's instructions]({authentication_info_url}) for how to get one.

reauth_token.description: Your Mobility Database refresh token is no longer valid. Enter a new one.

data_description.search_query: Provider or city name, for example 'LADOT' or 'Vienna'

search.description: Search the catalog by transit provider or city, then pick a feed from the results. Submit a new search to refine the results.
search.title: Find your transit feed

data_description.refresh_token: The long-lived refresh token from your Mobility Database account

user.description: Sign in to the Mobility Database with the refresh token from your account settings at {account_url}.

abort.not_ready: The transit schedule is still being prepared. Try again in a few minutes.

error.choose_one: Pick a zone or a map area.
error.no_stops_in_zone: No stops found in this area. Try a larger radius or a different location.

data_description.headsigns: Only departures with these headsigns are shown

headsigns.description: Optionally limit departures to specific destinations (headsigns). Leave empty to include all.
headsigns.title: Filter by destination

data_description.route_ids: Only departures on these routes are shown

routes.description: Optionally limit departures to specific routes. Leave empty to include all routes.
routes.title: Filter by route

data_description.stop: The stop or station to track departures for

data_description.location: A circle on the map to search for stops
data_description.zone: An existing Home Assistant zone to search for stops. Takes precedence over the map area.

user.description: Pick an existing zone or draw a circle on the map. Stops inside the area are offered in the next step.
user.title: Choose a search area

static_index_not_ready.message: The transit schedule index is not ready yet.

stop_missing.description: The stop {stop_name} is no longer present in the latest schedule published for {feed_title}. Its sensors are unavailable. Remove the stop and add a nearby replacement if it has been permanently retired.
stop_missing.title: Transit stop no longer in schedule
